Tap: Pantheon thrusts his spear, dealing [70 / 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 + (1.15) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to enemies hit. Refunds [60]% of this Ability's Cooldown.

Hold: Pantheon hurls his spear, dealing [70 / 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 + (1.15) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.5) × AP] physical damage to the first enemy hit and [50]% less to further targets. 

This Ability is enhanced against enemies below [20]% Health to deal [(70 / 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 + 85 / 130 / 175 / 220 / 265) + (2.3) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage instead.

Mortal Will Bonus: Deals an additional [characterLevelInterpolation(20 → 240; raw flags preserved) + (1.15) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage.

builds.name: Shield Vault: HP and AP physical leap
builds.summary: Investigate high one Shield Vault initial leap output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Shield Vault initial leap output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The initial leap deals an enemy-maximum-HP physical fraction of 6/6.5/7/7.5/8% plus 0.00004 per bonus HP and 0.00015 per AP. Both bonus HP and AP increase that fraction. Although AP scales it, physical mitigation applies; magic penetration does not improve this packet.
